In the bear enclosure, an area of the fence had been cut to provide larger enrichment without opening the enclosure. The
cut welded wire mesh edges left pointed, exposed ends where a paw or face could get injured, and therefore did not
protect the animals in the enclosure from injury. The facility must be constructed of such material and of such strength as
appropriate for the animals involved. The out door housing facilities shall be structurally sound and shall be maintained in
good repair to protect the animals from injury in order to ensure the welfare of the animals.
